interpretation.statistical_calibration: supported only for the stated synthetic generator

limitations: Synthetic Gaussian log-noise and stationary-rate assumptions.
Planner confidence is not a proven joint forecast coverage guarantee.
Weights cancel algebraically in the current closure condition.
Feedback calibrates aggregate selected-set lift rather than identifying individual mechanism effects.
M > 16 planner branch is not covered by the 1500-world default.
Zero residuals are dropped; target crossing/overshoot is not modeled.
Cause attribution is a modeling assumption, not identifiable from rate data alone.
required_revalidation: Real transition replay against strongest no-build baseline.
